{"action":"shell","command":"python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='/testbed/specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md'
content='''# Specification Quality Checklist: Tagged Cache (TaggedCache)

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Updated**: 2026-10-17 (milestone 3 R07/R08 entry expiry)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
  - Note: exception approved by task input - the milestone explicitly mandates
    `cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache`, `src/cachetools/tagged.py`,
    `cachetools.LRUCache`, `time.monotonic`, `timer`/`ttl` parameters, and
    `ValueError`/`KeyError` types; these are named contracts, not free choices.
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders (Given/When/Then scenarios)
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain (0 found; resolved via
  Assumptions A1-A13)
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous (FR-001..FR-028 each state a
  concrete observable behavior; FR-022..FR-028 added for milestone 3 R07/R08)
- [x] Success criteria are measurable (SC-001..SC-010; SC-009/SC-010 added
  for TTL boundary and purge-invisibility criteria)
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined (31 Given/When/Then scenarios
  across User Stories 1-5; User Story 5 added for R07/R08)
- [x] Edge cases are identified (23 edge cases; 8 added for R07/R08 TTL
  semantics, boundary, invalid TTL, purge ordering, and back-compat)
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded (additive module; A6, A7; expiry is entry state
  per R07/R08 and preserved by resize per FR-019)
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified (A1-A13; existing LRUCache;
  A9 records the superseded conflicting design note; A12 defines TTL value
  class and absolute-expiry computation; A13 defines purge/recency
  non-interference)

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows (P1 store/retrieve, P2
  invalidate/LRU, P2 multi-tag/resize/lazy-tags, P2 TTL entries, P3
  config/replacement safety)
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification (named contracts only,
  per task mandate)

## Notes

- All items pass; no spec updates required before `$speckit-plan`.
- Traceability: FR-001..FR-028 map to milestone requirements R01 (FR-002..004),
  R02 (FR-005..FR-009), R02 extension/Claim-A (FR-010), R03 (FR-001, FR-011,
  FR-012), API preservation (FR-013), R04 (FR-014..FR-016), R05 (FR-017,
  FR-018), R05 round-2 clarification (FR-019), R06 (FR-020, FR-021), R07
  (FR-022..FR-025), and R08 (FR-026..FR-028). See the Requirement
  Traceability table in spec.md. The conflicting old design note (empty
  all-tags matches every key; resizing may flush) is superseded by R04/R05 and
  recorded as assumption A9.
- Milestone 3 interaction recorded: FR-019 (resize preserves absolute expiry)
  is now fully in scope because R07/R08 define expiry as entry state; FR-019
  and FR-026..FR-028 are mutually consistent (purge happens before resize and
  does not recompute surviving expiries).
'''
open(p,'w').write(content)
print('ok checklist rewritten')
PYEOF"}
